issues.where: the shaken liquid, from the crown to the front of the pond
issues.what: The storm reads as a pale, diagonal corkscrew of thin hairs and a nearly opaque ribbon around the lower bowl. The target has finer layered, mostly sideways arcs punctuated by many recognizable pink petals, a darker pocket above the crown, and a localized warm flare around the lamp and tree. The candidate obscures the ground and pond too evenly while leaving the roof too readable.
issues.fix: Flatten the circulation into overlapping horizontal arcs, break up the continuous bottom ribbon, keep visible petal heads on more of the trails, and concentrate softer luminous occlusion around the lamp and tree while preserving the pond glint.

issues.where: the glass dome and its shoulders (also in set B)
issues.what: The wide, smooth white highlight at upper right and the oval double line under the crown look like hard molded plastic. The reference has a finer double contour, a textured cool shoulder reflection and warm grazing light that blooms strongest lower on the left. The left glass looks comparatively inert in the candidate.
issues.fix: Remove the crown oval, tighten and soften the upper-right strip, and move some of that light into a cool, textured shoulder sheen and a warm lower-left caustic.

issues.where: the front of the miniature landscape and the glass seat
issues.what: A tall green cutaway bank fills the lower globe and sits above a separate lumpy collar, making the miniature read as a raised disk. The target view continues nearly to the rounded seat, through a narrow, optically blended moss lip.
issues.fix: Lower and thin the visible front berm, let the pond and grass carry closer to the glass foot, and use a narrow contact shadow and curved refraction to seat the sphere into the moss rather than stacking two rims.

issues.where: the base from the left shoulder to the right foot (also in set B)
issues.what: The pedestal reads as a coarse, nearly vertical rock cylinder with chartreuse clumps and sharp tangles of brown roots. The target is more rounded and flared at the foot, with finer draping moss, softer wet blue-gray stone and fewer, fuller roots that flow over it. The right flank lacks the target's warm grazing edge light.
issues.fix: Round and flare the pedestal, refine the moss into short draping growth, restore the wet stone luster, simplify and round the root network, and put the warm grazing light back on the right flank.

issues.where: crop 1, rainwater on the unshaken shoulder
issues.what: The candidate mostly shows isolated speckled beads where the target has clearly connected, irregular downward rivulets as well as beads.
issues.fix: Join a subset of the beads into thin winding runoff lines with sharper bright and dark edges at the shoulder.

issues.where: the petal volume in the unshaken liquid
issues.what: Opaque pink flakes bunch over the house, tree and foreground; they are less clearly separated into crisp middle-distance petals, fine deep speckles and large soft foreground shapes than in the target. The broad uniform pink haze also erases some of the target's dark depth above the landscape.
issues.fix: Reduce the opaque clumps over the props, vary petal size, focus and backlighting with depth, and localize the warm haze instead of laying an even pink veil across the lower globe.

issues.where: crop 2, cottage masonry, roof, windows and door (also in set B)
issues.what: The roof is flatter and more uniformly tiled, the chimney taller-looking and more yellow, the masonry more evenly bright and gridlike, and the centered window glow broad and flat. The target has a rough dark slate roof with more moss, deeper irregular stone relief, narrow glowing apertures and a shaded recessed arched door.
issues.fix: Vary stone size and relief, darken and break up the roof slates with moss, make the chimney lower and chunkier, and reduce the window fill and restore the shadow in the arched door surround.

issues.where: crop 3, tree crown and branching below it (also in set B)
issues.what: Dense cauliflower-like clumps make a compact canopy with fewer clear gaps and blunter branch silhouettes; the heavy twisting trunk flares wider at the roots. The target has a more asymmetric spread with discrete fine sprays of flowers and luminous gaps around tapered branches.
issues.fix: Open gaps between sprays, vary their reach with fine twig detail, taper the trunk and root flare, and place warm backlight through the individual blossom clusters.

issues.where: the fence, planting, stepping stones, pond and lamp
issues.what: The fence is shorter in view and its rails disappear into the flowers; the planting is busier, the stepping stone curve largely disappears, and the pond has broad silvery ripples instead of legible concentric rings. The lamp's broad yellow lantern has less of the target's sharp warm center and narrow vertical reflection.
issues.fix: Bring the fence's diagonal run of posts and rails forward, break up the flower rows, restore the curved stepping stones and finer rings, and tighten the lamp core and its amber reflection.

issues.where: the surface immediately around and below the pedestal (also in set B)
issues.what: The candidate has clusters of flat, sharply cut salmon petals and a prominent green mirror edge over a cool blue surface. The target has more scattered cupped and translucent petals, wet pin glints, and a warmer but softer, darker reflection.
issues.fix: Disperse and curl the petals, add variation in their translucency and focus, darken the near-floor teal wash, and shift the reflected edge from green toward softer amber and pink highlights.

issues.where: the background bokeh and overall light (also in set B)
issues.what: The dark backdrop is flatter and more neutral-purple, with a pair of faint brown lights in place of the large warm oval beside the upper-left shoulder. The reference's cool blue-black field, warm oval highlights and warmer right-side glow produce stronger color separation.
issues.fix: Restore the slate-blue falloff, bring back the brighter oval at the left shoulder, and soften and warm the background and right-hand spill without reintroducing the compression texture.
